title: Vehicleworks Refined
description: This a a modpack all about what you can build and if you can survive this zombie infested world
body: Survive in a brutal, zombie‑infested world where ingenuity is your greatest weapon. Build and customize powerful vehicles, machines, and contraptions to defend yourself against relentless hordes and monstrous creatures. Gather resources, engineer your ultimate survival machine, and conquer the apocalypse through creativity and firepower. This modpack is directed towards mid-range to high end PCs, personally im getting around 90-100 fps because my pc isnt that powerful even though it has a gpu (I recommend allocating 6-8 gb of ram to the pack).
